displayName: loop-sessions: 8 or more Cloud Run instances for 15 min

conditions.displayName: active instances at 8 or more of maxScale 10

documentation.content:
The service is within two instances of its ceiling (maxScale 10) and has been for fifteen minutes. The baseline is one. Either the fleet is retrying in a storm (check the 5xx alerts and the heartbeat), or the database is slow and requests are queueing (check the Cloud SQL connection and CPU alerts), or somebody is walking the corpus through the read API.

`gcloud run services describe loop-sessions --region=<region> --format='value(status.traffic)'` for the revision serving; `gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="loop-sessions" AND jsonPayload.message="ingest batch"' --freshness=15m --format='value(jsonPayload.device_id)' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head` for who is sending.

Runbook: examples/deploy-gcp/README.md#runbook-ingest-5xx
